text_block_list.text: While observing training, I noticed Sounds of Earth speaking passionately to Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Please, my sweet pescatore.
All I desire is to see your smile.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, we can begin from pianissimo.
Come now, won't you sing for me?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
No, um... I'm fine.
P-Please don't mind me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Someone like me, who never shows any growth no matter how hard I train...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Grazie.
I hear you loud and clear. That means—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Dum.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Da-da-da-dum, da-da-da-dum—rest, rest.
Da-da-da-dum, da-da-da, da-da-da—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —'Boléro', isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the snare drum carving out a precise rhythm.
A resonance both andante and tempo giusto.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That is your sound. Even if it is not energico, a sincereness akin to religioso resides within it. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Benisssssssimo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: You are none other than a grand orchestra!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That precision of yours will eventually draw countless melodias along with it, leading toward a magnificent finale!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Just like—'Boléro'!!
Her way of speaking was far too eccentric to grasp the exact meaning, but from her bright expression...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...M-Me—a grand orchestra...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. Precisely so.
Therefore, pescatore, take pride in who you are.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Because your earnest étude will, without a doubt, become a magnificent sinfonia in time.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And... if possible, I would be delighted to be the very first to listen to your perfected armonia. Before anyone else, that is.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ah—
Thank you... very much...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —By the way, you there.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you. The bashful corno.
Or perhaps the shy ottavino.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It seems you too have a song you yearn to sing.
Won't you let me hear it, amico?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It seems you too have a song you yearn to sing.
Won't you let me hear it, amica?
Despite her unusual phrasing, I understood that she was calling out to me. In that case—
choice_data_list: Heh, I am but a capricious violin...
Heh, I am but a capricious violin...

text_block_list.text: Despite her unusual phrasing, I understood that she was calling out to me. In that case—
choice_data_list: Heh, I am but a capricious violin...
Heh, I am but a capricious violin...

text_block_list.text: ...I wonder why, but caught up in the mood, I blurted that out on impulse.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—!!
Bravo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—!!
Brava!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you are a violino!
Then I shall accompany you with an accordo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Pescatore, would you mind taking charge of this?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, let our jam session begin.
Musica celestialeeeeeee!

And so, our passionate session began.
The melody gradually grew more intense, eventually melting away into the sunset sky—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Such delicacy... Fufu,
just like the tip of a reed.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then how about expressing yourself with this?
Come, hold out your hands.
What she handed over was—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: There is no need to fear...! I promise to embrace everything! So—come!

Encouraged by Sounds of Earth's words, my hands moved naturally.
The vibration transferred directly into the maracas—

(*Shaka-shaka!! Shaka-shaka!!
Shaka-shaka-shaka-shaka!!*)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
!! What a fiery sound...!!
I feel it, I feel your passione!!
